contact.title: Contact
contact.intro: Have an idea for a figurine or a painting? Describe it – I'll reply with a quote and a date.

about.title: About me
paragraphs: I have been painting tabletop and RPG miniatures for over ten years – from single heroes to whole armies.
I also paint commissioned pictures: oils, acrylics and watercolours, often inspired by fantasy and night light.
I love dark, moody palettes, careful tonal transitions and details you only notice up close.

steps.title: Request
steps.text: You fill in the form: what you want to achieve, photos or inspirations and a deadline if you have one.

steps.title: Custom quote
steps.text: After your request I prepare a quote and a date tailored to your project.

steps.title: Painting
steps.text: I paint and send progress photos so you can ask for changes.

steps.title: Delivery
steps.text: The finished work reaches you carefully packed.

about.commissions: I take commissions for figurine painting and for paintings. Every commission is quoted individually.
